content.name: Second-Story Work
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement.
In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

content.name: Second-Story Work
entries: You've trained to get into especially hard-to-reach places, granting you these benefits.

entries.name: Climber
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}.

entries.name: Jumper
entries: You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.
